annotations.text:
Yoav — social templates for Instagram & Facebook (4:5, 1080×1350).
Shared language across all four: the three fading dots (a 'pause / breathe' cue), key-letter emphasis for fast reading, letters given air, text that never sits perfectly straight, a nature ground, and the same hand-signed 'yoav' leaf mark — so a reader recognizes it's yours before reading a word. Each style differs so a feed stays diverse. The writing shown is sample copy — swap it for your own by clicking the text.
HORIZON — warm sand, rising-sun glow, topographic contour rings. Cormorant Garamond italic on an arc. Calm, literary, hopeful. Best for a gentle turn or reassurance.
GROVE — sage green, swaying botanicals. Marcellus headline set in stepped, offset lines; Work Sans body. Grounded and alive. Best for a clear idea you want to land.
TIDE — dusk palette, drifting tide lines. Spectral italic riding a wave. Darker, weightier — 'this is important, slow down.' Best for depth, loss, courage.
FIELD — airiest and most minimal. Playfair Display, one big tilted thought, drifting motes, a single sprig. Poster-quiet. Best for a single line that should breathe.
